A print server is a computer system that allows computers connected to a network to deliver print

The print server centralizes printer control and brings eﬃciency to the whole prinƟng process,

A print server is a server that connects printers to the network. It enables users to share their

printers. 
Print servers are frequently uƟlized in businesses to streamline their prinƟng resources. It saves 
money and Ɵme. 
Print servers provide several beneﬁts over uƟlizing separate printers for each PC. It saves money on 
hardware and conﬁguraƟon and provides access control for the organizaƟon, leading to beter 
security of the organizaƟon’s sensiƟve informaƟon.
